title: A Return To Your Roots
description: Discover the significance of the Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach, collect thirty samples, and deliver them to Avrusa Sarethi at Sarethi Farm to continue Sinderion's research.

base_facts: I am a former student of the alchemist Sinderion.
I tend Sarethi Farm between Riften and Ivarstead.
Sinderion traveled to Blackreach to study the Crimson Nirnroot and never returned.
I would be grateful to anyone who completes Sinderion's field work.

CRIMSON_NIRNROOT_DISCOVERED: The player has discovered a Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach.
SINDERION_JOURNAL_READ: The player found Sinderion's remains and read his field journal requesting thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples.
NIRNROOT_COLLECTED: The player has collected thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples from Blackreach.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player delivered the Crimson Nirnroot and I pledged to continue Sinderion's research in his memory.
Player delivers thirty Crimson Nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi, completing the quest.
In order to get started, begin at the beginning in Sinderion's Field Laboratory .

To complete the quest even if the quest log does not represent the actual amount of Crimson Nirnroot you have in inventory simply go to Avrusa with thirty in your inventory, and the quest will complete itself without.
